[[The Darkness]] is a type of [[demon]] that defends [[The Greater Darkness]] in [[Ravenheart Gloom]]. Two of these creatures accompany the [[boss]] when you first encounter them and five more spawn when the original group is killed. Killing each of the reinforcements spawns five [[Earth Tormentor]]s.
